# Third-party repositories

Do not vendor third-party source into this repository without preserving upstream licenses.

Pinned commits are listed in docs/04_BASELINE_AUDIT.md.

Recommended local layout:
- third_party/Deform3DGS
- third_party/SurgicalGS
- third_party/EndoPlanar
- third_party/ColonSplat
- third_party/physiosplat

Prefer wrappers/patches in this repository over untracked edits inside third_party.
